def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants in species (strip extra spaces)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Fix label variants in island (strip + normalize case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric if needed
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert year to numeric if needed
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Filter to valid body_mass_g range
    df = df[df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500)]
    # Filter to allowed species
    allowed_species = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df = df[df['species'].isin(allowed_species)]
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: v for k, v in result.items()}
